Why go: a brand-new boat for your group's day

Amber is a 13 m speedboat built in 2026, with twin 300 hp engines, deep cushions, a sun deck and a proper enclosed toilet. A new boat matters on the longer runs to Koh Tao or Ang Thong, where comfort and reliability make the difference between a great day and a tiring one. Up to 10 guests pay one price, and up to 14 can come.

What you'll do

Pick a route. The afternoon honeymoon trip is designed for couples: snorkelling at Koh Ma on Koh Phangan, a beach restaurant at Haad Son and a sunset cruise home. The full days go to Koh Phangan's north coast, the southern islands of Koh Madsum, Koh Tan and Koh Rap, Ang Thong Marine Park from 16 December, or Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan for the clearest water in the Gulf.

Who it suits

  • Couples celebrating a honeymoon or anniversary.
  • Families and groups of 6–14 who want their own schedule.
  • Divers: try dives and fun dives can be added on request.

Who should choose something else

  • Small groups on a budget: our private speedboat to Pig Island or the shared Koh Tao day trip cost much less.
  • Anyone pregnant or with back problems: choose a catamaran such as Kia Ora.

Good to know

  • Fees: park and island fees are paid in cash on arrival; Koh Nang Yuan does not allow plastic bottles.
  • Sea: February to September is calmest; from October to December the captain may change the route for safety.
  • Ang Thong: closed every year from 1 November to 15 December.

Before you book

Choose your route and tell us your group size, any non-swimmers and whether anyone wants to dive. We confirm the pier and the start time, and arrange a van if you need one. For Koh Tao, start early to reach Koh Nang Yuan before the day-trip crowds.
